summary: In 2018, as NM-01 Representative, Haaland called the killing of sixty Palestinians in Gaza 'murder,' listed their names, and expressed personal grief during Ramadan. Her 2026 New Mexico gubernatorial platform addresses domestic priorities—criminal justice, healthcare, immigration, and environment—without reference to Israel, Palestine, or US military policy in the region.
